tools.name: auvo_list_users
tools.description: List the admin, manager and technician users of the Auvo account (paged). Auvo API: GET /users.

tools.name: auvo_get_user
tools.description: Return one Auvo user by id. Auvo API: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: auvo_list_customers
tools.description: List customers of the Auvo account (paged). Auvo API: GET /customers.

tools.name: auvo_get_customer
tools.description: Return one Auvo customer by id. Auvo API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: auvo_list_customer_groups
tools.description: List the customer groups of the Auvo account (labels that group customers). Auvo API: GET /customergroups.

tools.name: auvo_list_tasks
tools.description: List field-service tasks (work orders). Filter by date range, technician, customer, team or status. Auvo API: GET /tasks.

tools.name: auvo_get_task
tools.description: Return one Auvo task by id. Auvo API: GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: auvo_list_task_types
tools.description: List the task types (ids used when creating a task). Auvo API: GET /tasktypes.

tools.name: auvo_list_products
tools.description: List products (parts and stock items) of the Auvo account. Auvo API: GET /products.

tools.name: auvo_list_services
tools.description: List services (billable work items) of the Auvo account. Auvo API: GET /services.

tools.name: auvo_list_equipments
tools.description: List customer equipments (assets) of the Auvo account. Auvo API: GET /equipments.

tools.name: auvo_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams of the Auvo account. Auvo API: GET /teams.

tools.name: auvo_list_tickets
tools.description: List support tickets of the Auvo account. Auvo API: GET /tickets.

tools.name: auvo_get_ticket
tools.description: Return one Auvo ticket by id. Auvo API: GET /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: auvo_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices issued through Auvo. Auvo API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: auvo_list_receivables
tools.description: List receivables (amounts due from customers). Auvo API: GET /receivables.

tools.name: auvo_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses booked by users (for example travel or materials). Auvo API: GET /expenses.

tools.name: auvo_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer in the Auvo account. Creates a new record each call. Auvo API: POST /customers.

tools.name: auvo_create_task
tools.description: Create a field-service task for a technician. Creates a new task and notifies the assignee. Auvo API: POST /tasks.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: auvo_list_tickets, auvo_get_ticket · Private data: auvo_create_customer · Public sink: auvo_create_customer, auvo_create_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: auvo_list_tickets, auvo_get_ticket · Private data: auvo_create_customer · Public sink: auvo_create_customer, auvo_create_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
